scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm test:api
scripts.dev:auth: cd services/auth && NODE_ENV=development AUTH_MIGRATE_ON_START=1 tsx watch --env-file=../../infra/.env src/server.ts
scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run --env-file ../../infra/.env alembic upgrade head && uv run --env-file ../../infra/.env uvicorn --reload --no-access-log --port 8000 --factory radarnaque_api.main:create_app
scripts.dev: node scripts/check-ports.mjs 3000 8000 3100 && node scripts/check-docker.mjs && pnpm db:up && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d caddy searxng && pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n auth,api,site,admin,ext -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm dev:auth" "(pnpm exec wait-on -t 120000 http-get://localhost:3000/auth/health || (echo 'non démarré : /auth/health n a pas répondu 200 en 120 s' >&2; exit 1)) && pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:site" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:ext"
scripts.dev:stop: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml stop caddy searxng postgres
